::: {#rem-minimum-description-length-source}
#### Where the minimum description length principle comes from

@cover2006elements [section 14.13] state the principle
as the choice of the model
whose description plus the description of the data given the model is as short as possible.
They give the model's description length as its Kolmogorov complexity,
not as the length of a codeword from a chosen prefix code.

:::
